newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz, Ciba mull U.S. divestments.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz, Ciba mull U.S. divestments.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals groups Sandoz AG and Ciba-Geigy AG said on Wednesday they are discussing with potential buyers divestment options in their U.S. crop protection and animal health businesses.

The two companies, which in March announced a plan to merge, said in separate statements that they expected U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) clearance of their merger in late fall and that the divestiture sales were aimed at expediting this process.

Ciba said in its statement that the FTC talks have focused on crop protection and animal health businesses in the U.S. and the two companies anticipate that certain activities will have to be divested.

Ciba also stated that the potential divestitures were within its expectations and will not materially affect the overall transaction or the global position of the merged company, to be called Novartis, in Healthcare, Agribusiness or Nutrition. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
